commits.message: Alle aktuellen Änderungen im Projekt übernommen
API-Keys direkt im Code hinterlegt (RapidAPI, Sender.net, DCF)

feat: Enhanced company details modal with stock analysis integration

- Implemented stock analysis and insider trades buttons in company details modal
- Fixed modal ID references for proper stock analysis modal opening
- Optimized button layout with improved positioning and spacing
- Added responsive design for mobile devices
- Enhanced modal structure with better separation of concerns
- Improved button alignment and reduced unnecessary gaps
- Fixed border layout to span full width of modal content

Remove background and optimize spacing in stock analysis modal

- Removed gradient background from stock title section
- Eliminated border and border-radius for cleaner look
- Reduced spacing throughout stock overview section:
  * Gap reduced from 20px to 10px
  * Padding reduced from 16px to 8px vertically
  * Stock overview margin reduced from 30px to 20px
  * Stock overview padding reduced from 24px to 12px
- Added 12px left margin to stock name for better positioning
- Achieved more compact and minimalistic design

Remove hover effects from stock analysis modal

- Removed hover effects from .stock-title in analysis modal
- Eliminated gradient background changes on hover
- Removed border color transitions and transform animations
- Removed CSS transition property for cleaner, static display
- Maintains minimalistic design without interactive effects
- Stock name and price display now completely static

Fix stock name display issue and enhance minimalistic design

- Fixed stock name disappearing by ensuring full company name is passed from Yahoo Finance API
- Added fallback logic to show ticker symbol if company name unavailable
- Enhanced data processing to include meta.longName/shortName in analyzeData function
- Updated both updateUI and updateOverviewMetrics functions for consistent name display
- Increased stock price font size to 22px for better visibility
- Maintained minimalistic design with clean white text color
- Improved error handling and logging for stock name updates

feat: Implement insider trading style color formatting for YTD/52W performance and UI improvements

🎨 Color System Updates:
- Implemented insider trading modal color scheme for YTD/52W performance in stock analysis
- Added light green (#7FFF8E) for positive performance values
- Added light red (#ff8a80) for negative performance values
- Added neutral gray (#ccc) for N/A or error states
- Consistent color experience across both modals

🔧 Technical Implementation:
- Enhanced JavaScript logic to apply inline color styles based on performance values
- Added comprehensive CSS rules with high specificity for color override
- Implemented mobile-responsive color support for 480px and 360px breakpoints
- Added smooth color transitions for better UX

🎨 UI Polish:
- Rounded corners for analyze button (border-radius: 12px) for modern appearance
- Maintained minimalistic design while adding visual feedback
- Improved visual consistency between insider trading and stock analysis modals

✅ Cross-Modal Consistency:
- YTD/52W colors now match between insider trading and stock analysis modals
- Unified color language for performance indicators throughout the application
- Enhanced user experience with consistent visual cues

feat: Comprehensive mobile optimization and minimalistic design improvements

✨ Major Features Added:
- Two-card layout for analysis tab with Technical Indicators and Moving Averages & Volume sections
- Minimalistic tab selector with underline-based active state
- Minimalistic search bar with clean underline design and transparent button
- Dynamic color-coded YTD/52W performance indicators (green/red/gray)

📱 Mobile Optimizations:
- Stock price display stays right-aligned on mobile view
- Fixed YTD/52W performance alignment issues across all screen sizes
- Optimized text sizes for YTD/52W percentages
- Comprehensive responsive design for 768px, 480px, and 360px breakpoints
- Ultra-compact layouts for very small mobile devices

🎨 UI/UX Improvements:
- Removed Stock Price Chart title and icon for cleaner interface
- Enhanced analysis tab with organized card-based layout
- Improved visual hierarchy and spacing throughout
- Better color contrast and typography scaling

🔧 Technical Enhancements:
- Enhanced CSS specificity for consistent styling across all screen sizes
- Improved responsive grid systems for analysis indicators
- Optimized chart controls layout for mobile devices
- Better hover states and transitions for minimalistic design

All changes maintain full functionality while providing a more modern, clean, and mobile-friendly user experience.

Enhanced Stock Analysis Modal with comprehensive metrics and technical indicators

Features added:
- Expanded Metrics tab with 16 fundamental metrics (P/B ratio, EPS, Beta, ROE, etc.)
- Enhanced Analysis tab with 6 technical indicators (RSI, MA50/200, MACD, Volume, Bollinger Bands)
- Improved signal evaluation with color-coded buy/sell/hold indicators
- Added financial disclaimer for legal compliance
- Fixed YTD/52W performance color coding (green/red for +/-)
- Removed automatic search triggers, only manual button/enter search
- Improved timeframe button styling (white text)
- Removed percentage change display next to stock price
- Enhanced API data fetching for comprehensive financial metrics
- Better error handling and fallback mechanisms

Technical improvements:
- Consolidated CSS for better maintainability
- Enhanced Yahoo Finance API integration
- Robust data extraction with multiple fallback sources
- Improved signal calculation algorithms
- Better color coding throughout the interface

Update styles for mobile optimization

- Improve responsive design for mobile devices
- Adjust modal sizing and positioning
- Enhance mobile user experience

Remove exchange display from company details modal

- Clean up company meta information by removing exchange name
- Remove separator bullet point between ticker and exchange
- Simplify modal header to show only company name and ticker
- Improve visual clarity and reduce information clutter

Optimize company details modal for mobile view

- Reduce modal height for better mobile experience (768px: -120px, 480px: -80px)
- Add top padding for better positioning and visual balance
- Prevent horizontal scrolling with overflow-x: hidden
- Implement proper text wrapping with word-wrap and overflow-wrap
- Optimize grid layouts to prevent overflow (responsive min-max)
- Reduce content spacing and padding for compact mobile layout
- Ensure all elements use box-sizing: border-box for accurate sizing
- Improve typography scaling for mobile readability

Optimize earnings calendar for mobile view

- Make filter buttons and download button smaller on mobile devices
- Hide download button text on mobile, show icon only
- Reduce modal heights for better mobile experience
- Adjust padding and margins for compact mobile layout
- Improve responsiveness for 768px and 480px breakpoints

Enhanced Company Details Modal with comprehensive improvements

✨ New Features:
- Added detailed business descriptions for all 35+ companies in earnings calendar
- Implemented collapsible company descriptions (starts collapsed, expandable on click)
- Moved Insider Trades button next to company name for better UX
- Added automatic modal closure when switching between modals

📊 Company Data:
- Enhanced descriptions for AAPL, MSFT, JPM, NFLX, TSLA, C, WFC, BLK, BAC, PEP, JNJ, FAST, SLP, JBHT
- Added comprehensive data for GS, MS, PNC, PGR, UAL, AA, KMI, TSM, ABT, NVS, CTAS, USB, IBKR, TRV, AXP, SCHW, HBAN, RF, TFC, MMM, SLB
- Each company now includes sector, industry, financials, CEO info, and detailed business operations

🎨 UI/UX Improvements:
- Compact toggle button for description expansion/collapse
- Redesigned company header with inline Insider Trades button
- Improved modal navigation and cleanup
- Enhanced responsive design for company details

🔧 Technical Enhancements:
- Added closeAllModals() function for better modal management
- Improved event handling for description toggles
- Streamlined CSS with removal of unused styles
- Better accessibility with proper button tooltips and icons

Convert ICS events to all-day format and fix data source inconsistency

- Changed ICS earnings events from timed events to all-day events
- Removed duplicate EARNINGS_DATA definition in generateEarningsICS function
- Now uses global window.EARNINGS_DATA instead of local fallback data
- Implemented formatICSDateAllDay function for proper all-day event formatting
- Fixed DTSTART and DTEND to use VALUE=DATE format without timestamps
- Added error handling for missing earnings data
- Enhanced debug functions with debugICSContent for validation
- All earnings (before/after market) now appear as clean all-day calendar events
- Release timing information preserved in event descriptions

Fix ICS download RangeError and improve error handling

- Fixed RangeError: Invalid time value in generateEarningsICS function
- Improved date validation with isNaN check before processing
- Replaced problematic date string parsing with direct Date object creation
- Added robust error handling to skip invalid earnings entries
- Enhanced end time calculation to prevent date conversion issues
- Added console logging for better debugging
- Made EARNINGS_DATA globally available via window object
- Added multiple event listener approaches for better compatibility
- Implemented visual feedback for download success/failure states
- Added test function for debugging download functionality

Add ICS download functionality for earnings calendar

- Added download ICS button to earnings calendar modal
- Implemented generateEarningsICS() function to create RFC 5545 compliant calendar files
- Added downloadEarningsICS() function to handle file download
- Styled download button with hover effects and proper positioning
- ICS files include all earnings data with proper timing (before/after market)
- Calendar events include company details, EPS estimates, and revenue estimates
- Compatible with Google Calendar, Apple Calendar, Outlook, and other standard calendar apps

Fix earnings calendar weekdays to display in English

- Changed formatDayName function to use 'en-US' locale instead of undefined
- Weekdays in the earnings calendar date selector now show in English (Sun, Mon, Tue, etc.) instead of German (So, Mo, Di, etc.)
- Improves consistency for international users

Adjust mobile menu positioning: move content closer to top

- Reduced mobile menu padding-top from 90px to 30px
- Improved mobile menu accessibility by positioning content higher
- Maintains appropriate spacing while bringing menu items closer to top

Add Earnings Calendar feature with weekly view and filtering options

- Added new Earnings Calendar modal with interactive date selector
- Implemented weekly calendar view with current week highlighting
- Added filter options for before/after market earnings
- Created comprehensive earnings data structure for current week
- Enhanced mobile responsiveness for earnings calendar
- Added proper styling and animations for earnings calendar interface
- Integrated earnings calendar with existing navigation and mobile menu
Update index.html with apple-mobile-web-app-status-bar-style meta tag
Update script.js and style.css with latest changes

Update Fear & Greed Index modal and Market Summary content

- Simplified Fear & Greed Index modal layout with cleaner design
- Added last update timestamp display for better user information
- Updated Market Summary for July 14-18, 2025 trading week
- Focused content on Q2 earnings season and summer trading patterns
- Updated technical levels and sector outlooks for current market conditions

Improve portfolio charts and UI enhancements

- Add portfolio chart titles for better visualization
- Add timestamp display for Fear & Greed Index updates
- Reduce card gap spacing for better mobile layout
- Add new stock analysis styles file for future features
Enhanced backtest feature with custom checkbox styling and improved UI
